metadata.question: Does the snow cover extent in the Tinguiririca basin (specifically -34.752733, -70.647985) increase in December 18, 2023, compared to December 18, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS snow cover product (MOD10A1 or MYD10A1) or Sentinel-2 snow indices - Focus on December 18, 2023 vs December 18, 2021 - Location: Tinguiririca basin at (-34.752733, -70.647985) - Need to define a reasonable area around this point (buffer ~10-20km to capture basin extent) 2. Masking strategy: - For MODIS snow products, use the NDSI_Snow_Cover band - May need to mask clouds using QA bands - For snow extent comparison, count pixels with snow cover 3. Logic: - Valid result: Snow extent values for both dates (could be 0 snow = valid result B) - C1: No images found for either date - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare snow extent: if 2023 > 2021 → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-70.647985, -34.752733]); const basin = point.buffer(15000); // 15km buffer to capture basin area const date2021 = ee.Date('2021-12-18'); const date2023 = ee.Date('2023-12-18'); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Snow Cover const getSnowData = (date) => { return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(basin) .filterDate(date, date.advance(1, 'day')) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); }; let col2021 = getSnowData(date2021); let col2023 = getSnowData(date2023); const size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); const size2023 = col2023.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images: ${size2021}`); console.log(`2023 Images: ${size2023}`); // Fallback to MYD10A1 (Aqua) if Terra data missing if (size2021 === 0) { col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD10A1') .filterBounds(basin) .filterDate(date2021, date2021.advance(1, 'day')) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const newSize = col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Fallback (Aqua) Images: ${newSize}`); if (newSize === 0) { console.log('No data for 2021 after fallback.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } if (size2023 === 0) { col2023 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD10A1') .filterBounds(basin) .filterDate(date2023, date2023.advance(1, 'day')) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const newSize = col2023.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2023 Fallback (Aqua) Images: ${newSize}`); if (newSize === 0) { console.log('No data for 2023 after fallback.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Get first image and calculate snow extent const img2021 = col2021.first(); const img2023 = col2023.first(); // Snow pixels are where NDSI_Snow_Cover >= 10 (10% snow cover threshold) const snow2021 = img2021.gte(10); const snow2023 = img2023.gte(10); // 4. Calculate snow extent (area covered by snow) const stats2021 = snow2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: basin, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2023 = snow2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: basin, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2021 = snow2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: basin, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const snowPixels2021 = stats2021.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); const snowPixels2023 = stats2023.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); const totalPixels = count2021.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); console.log(`Total pixels analyzed: ${totalPixels}`); console.log(`2021 Snow pixels: ${snowPixels2021}`); console.log(`2023 Snow pixels: ${snowPixels2023}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in region.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (snowPixels2021 === null || snowPixels2023 === null || isNaN(snowPixels2021) || isNaN(snowPixels2023)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const snowExtent2021 = (snowPixels2021 / totalPixels * 100).toFixed(2); const snowExtent2023 = (snowPixels2023 / totalPixels * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`2021 Snow extent: ${snowExtent2021}%`); console.log(`2023 Snow extent: ${snowExtent2023}%`); if (snowPixels2023 > snowPixels2021) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
